name: post.unplan
description: Takes a post off the calendar and deletes it. The idea it came from goes back on the same day with its own words, and a suggestion stays a suggestion.
sql:
with p as (select * from brandbase.posts where id = :id and brand_id = :brand),
restored as (
  update brandbase.ideas i set post_id = null,
    day = case when p.format = 'story' then null else p.day end,
    why = coalesce(p.from_idea ->> 'why', i.why),
    status = case when (p.from_idea ->> 'suggested')::boolean then 'suggested' else i.status end,
    version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from p where i.post_id = p.id
  returning i.*
),
gone as (delete from brandbase.posts x using p where x.id = p.id returning x.id)
select jsonb_build_object('deleted', g.id, 'idea', (select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(r)) from restored r)) as result
from gone g
